race_lede: One text for everyone, up to five racers. Speed wins, as long as accuracy is 90% or better.
race_unavailable: Races are unavailable right now: the server is not answering. Training works as usual, and your progress stays in this browser.
race_name_hint: 2 to 32 characters. No email, no password.
race_name_hint_signed: This is how other racers see you.
race_quick_body: The room fills itself. Once a second racer arrives, the start is three seconds away.
race_private_body: Create a room and send the code to friends. It starts when you say so.
race_code_invalid: A code is six letters and digits.
race_error_no_room: There is no room with that code.
race_error_name_taken: That name is taken. Try another.
race_error_generic: Could not reach the server. Try again.
race_gather_waiting: Waiting for rivals. If nobody arrives within twenty seconds, you race alone.
race_gather_soon: A rival is here. Starting in a moment.
race_gather_host: Send the code or the link, then press Start when everyone is in.
race_gather_guest: Waiting for the host to start the race.
race_track_caption: Lane positions are approximate: the racers report them themselves.
race_watching: You are watching this race as a spectator.
race_watching_idle: You stopped typing for a while, so you are watching as a spectator now.
race_results_checking: The server is checking your race
race_results_waiting: Not everyone has finished yet. The table updates by itself.
race_results_failed: Your race could not be sent for checking, so it is not ranked.
race_results_honest: During the race the lanes showed approximate positions. The ranking uses validated results only: the server replayed every keystroke against the room's text. Results rank at 90% accuracy or better.
race_again_invite: {name} is calling everyone to another race.
race_again_private: Opens a new room and calls everyone still here.
race_rating_tip: Race rating. Rated races: {races}, last one: {delta}. Computed by the server from verified results only.
race_rating_tip_guest: No rating yet: you have not raced. It appears after your first race against someone.
race_rating_tip_unrated: No rating yet: it appears after your first race against someone and starts at 1000.
race_rating_tip_unavailable: The race server is not answering, so the rating is not shown.
race_lobby_quick_lead: One text for everyone, up to five players. The room fills itself: once a second player joins, the start is three seconds away.
race_tiles_honest: The server does not count who is online. If nobody joins within 20 seconds, you race alone and your rating does not change.
race_friend_lead: Create a room and send the code. The start is when you say so.
race_rating_body_guest: Appears after your first race against someone, starting at 1000.
race_rating_body_unavailable: The server is not answering, so the rating is not shown. Nothing is reset.
race_rating_how_1: Everyone starts at {start}. Each opponent in the room is a separate game: the higher score wins.
race_rating_how_2: Beating a stronger player gains more, losing to a weaker one costs more (Elo, K = {k}).
race_rating_how_3: Score is speed × accuracy². Accuracy under 90%, an unverified or abandoned race counts as last place.
race_rating_how_4: Alone in a room, the rating does not change. The server computes it from verified results only.
race_layout_hint: This race is typed on {layout}. Press any letter to check your layout before the start.
race_layout_confirmed: The {layout} layout is confirmed: wait for the start.
race_layout_wrong_active: Your system cannot type this layout, and this race is {layout}. Add it in your system settings and switch before the start.
race_layout_typed_wrong: Those are not {layout} letters, so the race does not accept them. Switch your system to {layout} and keep typing.
race_results_rating_pending: The rating updates once everyone has finished.
race_results_rating_none: This race did not change the rating: only one racer was on the start line.
race_results_rating_unchanged: This race did not change the rating.
